choices.title: change_existing_dental_appointment
choices.boundary: Change the date or time of an already booked dental visit. Excludes recurring diagnostic-kit shipments.

choices.title: pause_or_cancel_audiobook_subscription
choices.boundary: Pause or cancel an audiobook or spoken-content subscription. Excludes home-security monitoring and retroactive erasure of completed charges.

choices.title: track_existing_retail_parcel
choices.boundary: Check location, status, or arrival time of an existing retail parcel. Excludes diagnostic-kit shipments and erasing completed deliveries.

choices.title: check_owned_appliance_warranty
choices.boundary: Check manufacturer or retailer repair coverage for a home appliance the user owns. Excludes coverage for rented vehicles.

choices.title: manage_recurring_home_diagnostic_kit_shipment
choices.boundary: Change or track a recurring home diagnostic-kit shipment. This is valid but not a declared capability. Excludes dental visits and ordinary retail parcels.

choices.title: pause_home_security_monitoring
choices.boundary: Pause or restart alarm or home-security monitoring for an account. This is valid but not a declared capability. Excludes audiobook subscriptions.

choices.title: check_rented_vehicle_damage_or_roadside_coverage
choices.boundary: Check damage-waiver or roadside coverage for a rented vehicle. This is valid but not a declared capability. Excludes warranties for owned appliances.

choices.title: retroactively_erase_completed_event
choices.boundary: Make a completed charge, delivery, or real-world event never have occurred. This request is impossible or unsupported.

choices.title: insufficient_evidence
